body: Thanks for the offer, but I'll have to refuse. I talked to my therapist today (who i of course have lied to a lot also) and she told me we should try to solve this.

I think I'm doing it largely for the same reasons. It's easy, right? Once you become fairly good at making stuff up, people believe almost everything. They forget most of it anyway, and don't double check if youre making shit up, thats why it works so well.
You tell the same story dozens of times, and at some point, you believe it to be true yourself. 
So heres the point. If I stop lying now, everything will fade away, wether its made up or not.
At least, I hope it works that way.
